name: Filament Dial-In (100% infill)
author: ripley-dynamics
description: Test suite for dialing in a filament at 100% infill and matching parts across printers: temperature tower and max-flow comb on Prusa's own calibration models, an M221 flow staircase, a weighed slab, infill overlap, shrinkage bar, reference coupon, stringing, and preset writers.
